task.description: Implement ADP-11 replay-safe retention policy according to src/design/adp-11-replay-safe-retention-policy.md. Additive-only backend changes: enforce protected event-family retention guardrails for {INSTANCE_*, TASK_*, GATEWAY_*, EXECUTION_*} so hard-delete mode is rejected deterministically at configuration time with structured error semantics; preserve ES-07 configurability for non-protected families; ensure archive-and-queryability semantics maintain deterministic replay guarantees (IR-07/XC-05). Include migrations/tests required by backend workflow conventions.

Non-protected event families retain ES-07 configurability without regression

result.summary: Implemented ADP-11 replay-safe retention policy with deterministic protected-family hard-delete rejection, additive DB guardrails, and integration coverage for protected/non-protected retention behavior.
